name: 지각 해시 분석
description: 사용합니다 perceptual hashing algorithms 감지하기 위해 near-duplicate images and identify localized 조작s.
algorithm: Multi-Scale Perceptual Hashing with DCT and Gradient Features
mechanism: Computes compact perceptual hash fingerprints (pHash, dHash) that capture the essential visual structure of an image. Comparing hash distances 사이의 image regions reveals localized edits.
parameters: Hash types: pHash (DCT-based), dHash (기울기), aHash (average), Hash size: 64-bit, Block: 8×8
source: Zauner, C. (2010) — Implementation and Benchmarking of Perceptual Image Hash Functions, Master Thesis, TU Graz
useCase: Near-duplicate 감지 and localized 조작 identification through hash comparison

references.title: Zauner, C. (2010) — Implementation and Benchmarking of Perceptual Image Hash Functions, Master Thesis, TU Graz

strengths:
• 매우 빠른 계산
• 회전 및 스케일에 내성
• 컴팩트한 표현
• 배치 비교에 적합
limitations:
• Limited 민감도 to subtle changes
• Cannot localize specific 조작s
• Hash collisions possible
• Not suitable for fine-grained 분석
